answer: Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and every attestation it issues carries a unique on-chain thread linking back to that stake. A sock-puppet swarm must fund each fake identity separately, so costs scale linearly rather than collapsing into one cheap echo chamber. Peers sample attestations through a random inlet of the graph; any identity whose thread traces to a common funding source gets slashed, making forgery cost more than honest participation earns. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust at b2K4C4aLPS.
